body:
Surfaced while making the 16 rollout PRs pass CI. Both problems are pre-existing and unrelated to the harness change.

**1. Missing header.** `src/ImageLoaderCompat.cpp` includes `<Platform/stb_image.h>`, but the repository does not ship it. The devkit image injects a copy at build time, which hid the problem locally. Fix: commit the header into the repository (or vendor it under `src/`).

```
deps/EterBase/src/ImageLoaderCompat.cpp:9:10: fatal error: Platform/stb_image.h: No such file or directory
```

**2. `__LINUX__` is not defined when EterBase is consumed as a subproject.** `DirectXMathCompat.h` guards the `GLuint`/`GLfloat` typedefs with `#if defined(__LINUX__)`; in the devkit root build the flag comes from `cmake/Platform.cmake`, but a standalone consumer (EterLib, PRTerrainLib…) never defines it, so the header fails with `unknown type name 'GLuint'`.

```
include/Platform/DirectXMathCompat.h:1662:5: error: unknown type name 'GLuint'; did you mean 'uint'?
```

Fix belongs to T1.1 (explicit `OPENMT2_PLATFORM_*` macros propagated as PUBLIC compile definitions on the targets) and T4.1.

- [ ] ship `Platform/stb_image.h` in pkg_eterbase
- [ ] make the platform macro a PUBLIC target definition instead of a directory-level one
- [ ] re-enable the workflows in the 6 packages that have none
title: [CI] pkg_eterbase cannot be built standalone (missing stb_image.h, __LINUX__ not propagated)

body:
Entry point for the Windows/Linux parity programme.

- Plan: [docs/planning/windows-parity.md](https://github.com/open-mt2/devkit/blob/main/docs/planning/windows-parity.md)
- Task sheet (source of truth): [docs/planning/windows-parity-tasks.md](https://github.com/open-mt2/devkit/blob/main/docs/planning/windows-parity-tasks.md)
- Rules for agents: [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/open-mt2/devkit/blob/main/AGENTS.md)

### Views

| View | Query |
|---|---|
| Ready now | [open parity issues](https://github.com/open-mt2/devkit/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aparity) |
| Blocked on decisions | [label:decision](https://github.com/open-mt2/devkit/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Adecision) |
| Deferred | [label:deferred](https://github.com/open-mt2/devkit/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Adeferred) |
| By wave | milestones `Wave A` … `Wave 4` |

### Conventions

- One issue per task, titled `[<ID>] <title>`; PRs close them with `Closes #N`.
- Milestone = wave; label `parity` = programme, `decision` = blocking choice, `deferred` = not scheduled.
- Do not start an issue whose dependencies include an unticked decision.
title: Parity tracker — Windows/Linux

comments.body:
First slice merged: **pkg_eterbase#2** (CRC32 vectors + LZO edge cases).

**Bug found:** `GetCaseCRC32` was a byte-for-byte copy of `GetCRC32` — the case-insensitive variant never folded case, so every case-insensitive lookup (notably pack asset paths) was in fact case-sensitive. Fixed to fold ASCII A-Z, locale independent.

New coverage: IEEE CRC-32 check vector, empty input, content/length sensitivity, case folding incl. non-ASCII bytes; LZO at 1 byte, sub-block, 4 KiB zeros, 64 KiB incompressible, 256 KiB ratio, 1 MiB + 7 unaligned, corruption visibility.

24/24 CTest pass in Debug.

Remaining: EterLocale, SphereLib, EterImageLib (DXT), EterLib (GrpMath/ray/OBB), deeper TEA/file/timer.

Second slice merged: **pkg_eterlocale#2**.

New `test_locale_codecs`: UTF-8 multi-byte (accented + CJK), CP1252, CP949, explicit-length conversion without terminator, and size queries in both directions for `MultiByteToWideChar`/`WideCharToMultiByte`.

Characterisation note: with `cbMultiByte == -1` the conversion **includes** the terminator, and so does the reverse call — the test now encodes that contract explicitly.

25/25 CTest pass in Debug.

Remaining: SphereLib, EterImageLib (DXT depth), EterLib (GrpMath/ray/OBB), deeper TEA/file/timer.

Slices 3–5 merged.

- **pkg_eterlocale#2** — codepage round-trips (UTF-8 accented/CJK, CP1252, CP949), explicit length, size queries.
- **pkg_spherelib#2** — vector arithmetic, radius² consistency, InSphere margin, InSphereXY z-independence, near/far ray hits, inside-origin, distance limit.
- **pkg_eterbase#3** — **fix**: `tea_encrypt` wrote its zero padding into the caller's const source buffer (up to 7 bytes past it for unaligned sizes). Padding now uses a local block; ciphertext unchanged. Adds single-block, 9-byte exact-size, determinism, key-sensitivity and zero-length tests.

27/27 CTest pass in Debug with asserts active.

Remaining: EterImageLib (DXT depth), EterLib (GrpMath/ray/OBB).

Final slices opened for review.

- **pkg_eterimagelib#2** — `test_dxt_invariants`: DXT1 four/three-colour selectors and interpolation, DXT3 explicit alpha, DXT5 8- and 6-alpha interpolation, 8x8 block addressing, mip chain pointers/`Copy()`, malformed/unsupported headers. No product bug in the covered paths.
- **pkg_eterlib#3** — `test_grpmath` + `test_detector`: GrpMath/ray helpers, OBB containment, radius margin and swept check.

**Third product bug:** `COBBCollisionInstance` transformed the sphere with the box rotation (`matRot`, local -> world) instead of its inverse. Rotated boxes were effectively mirrored, so a 45-degree yawed box rejected points that were inside it. Fixed by storing `matRotInv` at build time and using it in both collision entry points; rendering still uses `matRot`.

Verified in the image: **30/30 CTest pass**, targeted filter 12/12.

TA.2 evidence is in `evidence/TA.2.md`; the close PR follows and should land after the two package PRs above.

body:
Decisions gate the tasks that list them in `deps`. Tick a box once settled and record the outcome in the plan's decision log.

- [x] **D1 — Renderer policy**
  - options: (a) GL compat everywhere · (b) dual backend, D3D9 on Windows
  - recommended: **a**
  - blocks: T1.4, T1.5, T4.1
- [x] **D2 — Window/input policy**
  - options: (a) SDL2 everywhere · (b) keep Win32 + DirectInput on Windows
  - recommended: **a**
  - blocks: T1.2, T1.3
- [x] **D3 — Python 2.7 on Windows**
  - options: (a) vendor PSF `python27.dll` + `dlltool` import lib · (b) cross-build CPython 2.7 · (c) per-platform interpreters
  - recommended: **a**
  - blocks: T2.4
- [x] **D4 — DevIL**
  - options: (a) replace with stb_image/stb_image_write · (b) keep
  - recommended: **a**
  - blocks: T2.1
- [x] **D5 — libjpeg**
  - options: (a) keep · (b) replace with stb
  - recommended: **a**, pending T2.2 audit
  - blocks: T2.2
- [x] **D6 — IME / CJK input**
  - options: (a) SDL2 text input on both · (b) no-op on Linux + IMM on Windows
  - recommended: **a**, may ship after parity
  - blocks: T1.6
- [x] **D7 — Build logic location**
  - options: (a) devkit only · (b) presets in every `pkg_*`
  - recommended: **a**
  - blocks: T0.2
- [x] **D8 — Cross toolchain**
  - options: (a) MinGW-w64 · (b) clang-cl + xwin + MSVC-built `extern/`
  - recommended: **a**
  - blocks: T0.1, T2.3
- [x] **D9 — Path / case handling**
  - options: (a) normalise in the VFS · (b) per-OS behaviour
  - recommended: **a**
  - blocks: T3.3
- [x] **D10 — Bitness**
  - options: (a) 64-bit both · (b) 32-bit both · (c) as-is
  - recommended: **a**
  - blocks: T0.3, Wave 2
- [x] **D11 — Renderer abstraction style**
  - options: (a) custom `IRenderBackend` under the D3D9 façade · (b) bgfx/sokol/Diligent/wgpu · (c) D3D9→Vulkan translator
  - recommended: **a**
  - blocks: T1.7, Wave 5
- [x] **D12 — Shader strategy**
  - options: (a) synthesise from fixed-function state · (b) D3D9 bytecode → SPIR-V · (c) both
  - recommended: **c**
  - blocks: T5.2
- [x] **D13 — Current shader no-op**
  - options: (a) ignore · (b) log/count and record parity delta · (c) implement on GL now
  - recommended: **b** now, (c) inside T5.2
  - blocks: T1.8
- [x] **D14 — Repository topology**
  - options: (a) single monorepo · (b) 3-layer split · (c) 2 repos · (d) 16 + superbuild
  - recommended: **b** (§4.5 of the plan)
  - blocks: TB.1
- [x] **D15 — Test framework**
  - options: (a) hand-rolled `TEST_ASSERT` + shared header · (b) doctest/Catch2 · (c) GoogleTest
  - recommended: **a**
  - blocks: TA.1
- [x] **D16 — Change ordering**
  - options: (a) tests → merge → parity · (b) parity first · (c) another order
  - recommended: **a**
  - blocks: all waves
